supporting_reports.evidence: After ingesting a large bird at 3,000 feet the crew received an engine fire warning, shut the engine down and discharged the fire extinguisher.
The engine vibrated and lost thrust, and the crew shut it down and returned.
Multiple bird strikes during the takeoff roll caused the right engine to surge, and the crew rejected the takeoff.

concerns: All supporting reports are co-coded BIRD. SAMPLE-030 is a bird strike without engine effects and is excluded.
